Class CountdownIterator Implements Iterator
    Property Value As Integer
    Property Current As Integer

    Constructor(start As Integer)
        Me.Value = start + 1
        Me.Current = 0
    End Constructor

    Function MoveNext() As Boolean
        Me.Value = Me.Value - 1
        If Me.Value >= 0 Then
            Me.Current = Me.Value
            Return True
        End If
        Return False
    End Function
End Class
